title: Sunflower
description: One sunflower clump for a 1 m field cell: two green stalks with diamond leaves, each topped by a big yellow star-petal face with a raised brown seed disc, facing +Z and tipped back a little toward the sky. A single mesh node `crop` (materials crop + petal + seed), instanced by the thousand.
checks: FRONT tile: two big yellow faces with brown centres look straight at the camera
BACK tile: the faces show from behind as yellow (not see-through)
LEFT tile: the faces tip back slightly (looking up and toward the front end); stalks start on the grid line
TOP tile: everything stays inside the 1 m cell
